verdict.rationale: Speculative decoding is a fair performance axis for an on-device inference SDK and engine, but nothing in the evidence mentions speculative decoding, draft models or similar techniques. The hardware acceleration claims (Hexagon NPU, silicon-validated kernels, MetalRT throughput benchmarks) are adjacent performance features, not speculative decoding, so they earn no credit.
